id.description: A unique identifier for the knowledge source

external_id.description: An external identifier for the knowledge source

name.description: The name of the knowledge source

metadata.description: A dictionary of arbitrary key,value pairs.                     This data is not used by Ada, but can be used by the client to store additional information about                     the knowledge source.

created.description: The date the knowledge source was created

updated.description: The date the knowledge source was last updated

last_sync.description: The date the knowledge source was last synchronized

status.description: Deletion lifecycle status of the knowledge source: `deleting` while an asynchronous deletion is in progress, `delete_failed` if the deletion failed. `null` when no deletion is in progress.
